chunks: Al-Ḥalabī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about prayer in
sheep pens, and he said: “Pray there, but do not pray in camel enclosures unless you fear the loss of your belongings; then sweep it, sprinkle it with water, and pray in it.”
He said: “Prayer in saline land is disliked unless it is a soft place upon which the forehead may rest evenly.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) in sheep pens, camel enclosures, or saline land?
ai.summary: This hadith gives fiqh rulings about valid and disliked places for salat (prayer). It permits prayer in sheep pens, discourages prayer in camel enclosures except in necessity after cleaning the place, and considers prayer in saline land disliked unless the ground is soft and level for proper sajdah.
